scope: Read-only source applicability assessment, not a package migration or native behavioral validation.

current_bundled_package.nominal_expression_observation: No agauss, mm_ok or is_fac_mm expressions occur in the bundled nominal sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib.
current_bundled_package.corner_observation: hbt_typ/hbt_bcs/hbt_wcs include sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib; corresponding mismatch sections include the separate sg13g2_hbt_mod_mismatch.lib.

official_upstream.title: hbt: fix unwanted mismatch variations in repeated simulations

diff_observations.new_corner_values: All ten are zero in nominal and hbt_typ_stat sections. Mismatch sections receive the previous literal magnitudes: 0.038, 0.130, 0.010, 0.017, 0.010, 0.028, 0.055, 0.010, 0.010, 0.010.

applicability_conclusion.reason: The previous-dev expressions targeted by this fix are absent from the current bundled nominal library. The newer upstream model structure already differs from the bundled package. The patch addresses a source-reported later-upstream repeatability issue, not a demonstrated reproduction in this bundled deterministic package.
applicability_conclusion.current_mismatch_behavior: Not executed in this assessment. Absence of the nominal expressions does not establish correctness or calibration of separate mismatch/statistical models.
required_before_migration: Review complete intervening source/model/interface/parameter changes from bundled revision to proposed pinned target, not only the latest two-file merge.
Authenticate complete licensed include/model closure and create a separately versioned package with regenerated provenance and contracts.
Run pinned native repeated nominal simulations across applicable corners and models, with fresh-process and repeated-in-process controls.
Verify explicit mismatch enable/disable, seed reproducibility and intended variation independently; retain raw decks, logs, outputs and fault controls.
Treat silicon calibration, correlation and valid operating/reliability envelopes as separate evidence requirements.

unexecuted_li_array_next_cohort.purpose: Extend actual-array native-extracted electrical linkage to transient and thermal noise, which are not established by the existing array DC/AC cohort.
unexecuted_li_array_next_cohort.existing_evidence_not_to_repeat_as_progr: The accepted single-unit linked and 280-layout metal-resistor array DC/AC cohorts are not new acceptance.
proposed_checks: Actual application-exported array reference versus fresh native-extracted complete network versus independently constructed literal reference.
Transient waveform comparison with declared load/stimulus, tolerances and finite time grid.
Thermal-noise density/integrated-noise comparison with declared measurement port, source/load, frequency band, temperature and independent expectation.
Missing-unit, broken-branch and one-unit-width perturbations must be detected for their intended electrical/physical reason, not a tool failure.
Independent raw-artifact audit with exact model/tool/source/layout/extraction/runner identities and altered-evidence controls.
prerequisites: Authenticate and make executable the pinned native ngspice/Magic/Netgen runtime; these binaries were not available on local PATH at inspection.
Retain fresh complete native DRC/LVS/extraction evidence for each selected actual array, or explicitly authenticate reusable evidence without calling it a new physical run.
Version/review new dynamic acceptance contract, runner, independent auditor and tests before execution.
Use a clean exact candidate identity and preserve source/package/runtime hashes and all raw simulator/extractor artifacts.
not_closed_by_this_cohort: Complete geometry, bias/current/power, temperature and reliability envelopes
Measured sheet-resistance conditions and nominal source discrepancy
